title: 第64章 让他们知道我不是好欺负的

第64章 让他们知道我不是好欺负的-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强看着她：“大哥家去年就买电视机了，你咋不找他要？”

李红霞一噎：“你大哥那是……那不一样。”

“哪不一样？”

“你大哥家里困难，两个孩子要养。”

“我三个孩子要养。”

李红霞脸色不好看了：“你现在开着店，一天挣多少钱以为我不知道？买台电视机算什么？”

“我挣的钱，是我起早贪黑干出来的。”

林国强语气平静，“不是我欠谁的。”

李红霞被怼得说不出话，眼珠子一转，又换了说辞：“行，不买新的也行。

你把这台搬老宅去，你跟素梅想看，就去老宅那边看。”

林国强笑了。

但眼睛里一点笑意都没有。

“妈，大哥家的电视机买了一年了，你咋不搬他的？”

“你大哥那是……”

“那是什么？”林国强打断她，“你觉得我这个当老二的好欺负？”

这句话说得不重，但院子里外都听见了。

李红霞脸上挂不住了：“你说啥呢？谁欺负你了？”

“我说的不对吗？”林国强看着她，“大哥买电视，你没吭声。

我买电视，你让我搬老宅去。

老三还没买，你替他着急，妈，都是你儿子，凭啥？”

李红霞张了张嘴，说不出话。

“你跟爹想看电视，随时来我这儿看。”

林国强说，“去大哥家看也行，老三两口子想看，让他们自己买。

又不是没手没脚，凭啥让我买？”

说完，他转身回了院子。

李红霞站在院门口，脸上青一阵白一阵。

周围邻居都低着头，假装看电视，耳朵却竖得老长。

最后她一跺脚，骂了句“白眼狼”，悻悻走了。

李红霞回到老宅的时候，屋里正吵得不可开交。

徐青青坐在炕沿上，眼圈红红的，显然是哭过。

林国栋蹲在门槛上，闷着头抽烟。

“我不管！”徐青青拍着炕沿，“老大老二家都有电视机了，凭啥咱家没有？我嫁给你是来受穷的吗？”

林国栋烦躁地抓了抓头发：“买买买，拿啥买？我跑一趟运输才挣几个钱？

咱俩吃喝拉撒哪样不要钱？你当我开银行的？”

“那老大老二怎么买得起？”

“老大采石场干这么多年攒的，老二开店挣的，我哪有那本事？”

徐青青一听更来劲了：“你没本事你还有理了？我当初怎么瞎了眼嫁给你？”

李红霞进门就听见这话，脸色一沉：“吵什么吵？让邻居听见笑话不笑话？”

Lin Guoqiang looked at her: "My eldest brother's family bought a TV last year. Why don't you ask him for it?"

Li Hongxia choked: "Your eldest brother, that's... that's different."

"What's the difference?"

"Your eldest brother's family is in trouble and he has two children to support."

"I have three children to support."

Li Hongxia's face turned ugly: "Now that you are running a store, you think I don't know how much you earn in a day? What's the point of buying a TV?"

"The money I earn is from working early in the morning and working late in the day."

Lin Guoqiang said calmly, "I don't owe anyone anything."

Li Hongxia was so stunned that she couldn't speak. She rolled her eyes and changed her words: "Okay, it's okay if you don't buy a new one.

You move this to the old house. If you and Sumei want to see it, go to the old house and watch it."

Lin Guoqiang smiled.

But there was no smile at all in his eyes.

"Mom, it's been a year since I bought my eldest brother's TV, why don't you move it?"

"Your elder brother is..."

"What is that?" Lin Guoqiang interrupted her, "Do you think I, the second child, are easy to bully?"

The words were not spoken seriously, but they were heard both inside and outside the yard.

Li Hongxia lost her composure: "What are you talking about? Who bullied you?"

"Am I wrong?" Lin Guoqiang looked at her, "Brother bought a TV, but you didn't say anything.

I buy a TV, and you ask me to move to my old house.

The third child hasn’t bought it yet, so you’re worried about him. Mom, they’re all your sons, so why?"

Li Hongxia opened her mouth but was speechless.

"If you and dad want to watch TV, you can come to my place anytime."

Lin Guoqiang said, "You can go to the eldest brother's house to watch it. If the youngest couple wants to see it, let them buy it themselves.

It’s not like I have no hands or feet, so why should I buy it?"

After saying that, he turned and returned to the yard.

Li Hongxia stood at the entrance of the courtyard, her face turning blue and white.

The neighbors all lowered their heads and pretended to watch TV, but their ears stood up.

Finally, she stamped her foot, cursed "white-eyed wolf", and walked away angrily.

When Li Hongxia returned to her old house, there was a lot of noise in the house.

Xu Qingqing sat on the edge of the kang, her eyes were red, she had obviously cried.

Lin Guodong squatted on the threshold, smoking with his head down.

"I don't care!" Xu Qingqing patted the edge of the kang, "Boss and the other two have TVs at home, so why don't we? Did I marry you to suffer poverty?"

Lin Guodong scratched his hair irritably: "Buy, buy, buy, what should I buy? How much money can I make from a transportation trip?"

How can we eat, drink, and have sex for free?Do you think I open a bank?"

"Then how can the boss and the second child afford it?"

"The eldest brother has earned money from working in the quarry for so many years, and the second brother has earned it from opening a shop. How can I have that ability?"

Xu Qingqing became even more excited when she heard this: "How can you still be reasonable if you have no ability? Why did I blindly marry you in the first place?"

Li Hongxia heard these words when she entered the door, and her face darkened: "Why are you making such a fuss? Are you going to let the neighbors hear the joke or not?"
